rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) with no third-party involvement is straightforward property damage.
claim_summary: Wind damage to back porch roof overhang; approximately four shingles blown off with no water intrusion. Estimated repair cost $400. Policyholder's $2,500 deductible exceeds the damage estimate.

case_facts.description: Wind blew approximately four shingles off; no water intrusion or secondary damage
